name: Acid Arrow

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Ranged spell attack; initial Acid and target-next-turn-end Acid on hit; miss only half initial; higher slots scale both amounts; delayed component cannot repeat initial payment.

rules.text: A shimmering green arrow streaks toward a target within range and bursts in a spray of acid.
Make a ranged spell attack against the target.
On a hit, the target takes 4d4 Acid damage and 2d4 Acid damage at the end of its next turn.
On a miss, the arrow splashes the target with acid for half as much of the initial damage only.
The damage (both initial and later) increases by 1d4 for each spell slot level above 2.
